faqs.question: Are all DP Motorhub parts 100% authentic BMW M Performance OEM?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every single component in our catalog is guaranteed 100% authentic BMW M Performance hardware, manufactured according to rigorous BMW AG motorsport tolerances and sealed in official factory packaging with hologram security tags.

faqs.question: How does VIN fitment verification work?
faqs.answer: Before preparing any shipment or installation, our technical team verifies your vehicle's 17-digit Chassis VIN against the BMW AG electronic parts catalog (ETK) to guarantee 100% compatibility with your exact build options.

faqs.question: Can I visit the Kadawatha showroom for collection and workshop installation?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. You can collect your parts or have them professionally installed by our certified technicians at our facility located at 325/1/A/3, Ihala Biyanwila, Kadawatha.

faqs.question: How do I contact DP Motorhub for technical support or special orders?
faqs.answer: You can reach our dedicated technical team via our official email hello@dpmotorhub.com or via WhatsApp at +94 77 123 4567 during business hours (Mon - Sat: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM).
